Class ExplanationList

java.lang.Object
edu.uky.cs.nil.sg.StoryGraphCollection<Explanation>
edu.uky.cs.nil.sg.StoryGraphList<Explanation>
edu.uky.cs.nil.sg.NumberedList<Explanation>
edu.uky.cs.nil.sg.ExplanationList
All Implemented Interfaces:
Iterable<Explanation>, RandomAccess
public class ExplanationList extends NumberedList<Explanation>
The list of explanations in a story graph, which document the plans that a character wants to taken in a given node.
Author:
Stephen G. Ware

    • add

      public Explanation add(Node node, Character character, Plan plan)
      Creates a new explanation for a character that has formed a plan at some node in a story graph. If the character given is null, the plan represents a plan for the story author.

      This method does not check whether an explanation with the same node, character, and plan already exists; it always adds a new explanation.

      This method updates the story graph's meta-data last modified timestamp.

      Parameters:
      node - the node at which the character forms a plan
      character - the character forming the plan
      plan - the plan the character forms
      Returns:
      a newly created explanation that has been added to this list
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if the node, character, or any of the actions in the plan have been removed or were not created in this list's story graph
